title: Tazhib gilding
summary: Draw the pattern of an illuminated headpiece in sticky size, lay the gold leaf over it, then flood the ground in lapis blue and the leaves in turquoise and red.
howToPlay: The framed page shows the finished headpiece.
Tap Dip and draw each lit line with the size; the pattern repeats on all four sides.
Press Gild to lay the gold leaf.
Pick a colour and tap a shape to flood it.
rules: Score: how closely your lines follow the guide, and how much of each shape holds the right colour.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Watch and learn plays a whole round for you, and Undo takes back the last step.
heritageNote: Tazhib means gilding. In Persian and Ottoman books the illuminator drew the pattern in size, pressed on thin gold leaf, burnished it with an agate, and then painted the grounds and leaves in lapis, turquoise and red.
